newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Minera Autlan started as hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Minera Autlan started as hold.

text.p: -- Valores Finamex initiated coverage of Mexican miner Compania Minera Autlan with a hold rating.
-- Analyst Christopher Albi said the market for silicomanganese, the company's main product, has weakened considerably this year after a strong 1995.
-- He said prices are not expected to recover until 1997.

-- Beginning in the fourth quarter, the company will no longer enjoy favourable year-over-year comparisons, he said. -- "For these reasons, we do not expect the shares to outperform the IPC in medium-term although we continue to like the company's long-term prospects." Valores Finamex estimates earnings of 1.211 pesos per share in 1996 and 1.393 pesos in 1997, he said.
